purpose: Determine whether the generic government_debt_issuance feedback node has a definitionally matched observed source, and prevent RMD from conflating domestic primary-market securities issuance, total Ministry borrowing, refinancing need, QSA net incurrence, and debt-stock changes.

observed_scope: Romania S13 general-government F3 gross issues
sources.semantic_strength: Official security-by-security-derived source family that explicitly separates gross issuance, redemptions, net issues and non-transaction stock changes, enabling a scientifically complete F3 stock-flow boundary if exact common component series are retained.
semantic_limits: F3 only; it does not cover AF2 or AF4 Maastricht debt instruments
market-value and non-consolidated CSEC boundaries are not the Maastricht nominal/face-value consolidated debt boundary
the exact all-maturity/all-currency six-component series set must be source-probed and retained rather than inferred from key syntax
CSEC gross issues are not government financing need and do not by themselves define market supply pressure

observed_scope: discount treasury certificates nominal value in RON
treasury certificates nominal value in EUR when present
interest-bearing government bonds allotted amount in RON
government bonds nominal value in EUR when present
sources.semantic_strength: Strong candidate for a domestic-primary-market securities issuance observable because the table explicitly covers new and roll-over issues at monthly frequency.
semantic_limits: does not by itself represent all Ministry borrowing
does not include the full external Eurobond/loan financing boundary
does not automatically represent retail-government-securities issuance on the Ministry all-instruments boundary
monthly primary-market issue volumes are not refinancing need
monthly issue volumes are not a validated securities-supply-pressure state

sources.section: Actual borrowings in 2025 / by instrument, currency and market
sources.frequency: monthly report with cumulative year-to-date actual borrowing values
sources.semantic_strength: Strong candidate for realized Ministry borrowing/financing by instrument across domestic and external markets.
semantic_limits: reported values are cumulative year-to-date rather than a frozen monthly flow table
foreign-currency instruments are converted to RON using stated forecast average exchange rates and conversion assumptions may change across report vintages
RON Treasury-bond line may include exchange operations
local-government borrowing is separate from central-government MoF borrowing
cash-management instruments are separately identified and may mature within the year
all-in borrowing is broader than debt-securities issuance because it also includes loans/RRF drawings

sources.evidence: 2025 financing plan and redemption profile; gross financing needs are presented separately from domestic/foreign debt redemption and financing sources.
sources.semantic_strength: Confirms that gross financing need, redemptions and issuance/funding are distinct concepts.
semantic_limits: financing plan is not realized issuance
redemption profile is not actual gross issuance

qsa_f3_net_incurrence.meaning: financial-account net incurrence of F3 liabilities

bnr_domestic_primary_market_issue_volume.meaning: monthly new and roll-over domestic primary-market government-securities issues by instrument/currency

mof_actual_borrowing.meaning: realized cumulative borrowing by instrument/market under Ministry public-debt reporting

candidate_future_split.best_current_source: ECB CSEC Romania S13 F3 securities issues
candidate_future_split.likely_role: candidate gross inflow to a separately defined market-valued S13 F3 securities stock-flow submodel; not a direct Maastricht debt-stock update
candidate observed driver for a narrowly defined domestic issuance/yield transmission path
candidate financing-flow observable for a broader government financing/refinancing structure

scientific_decision.next_step: Execute the frozen CSEC Romania S13 F3 materialisation contract to retain one exact common boundary for gross issues, redemptions, net issues, stocks, revaluations and other changes. Raw BNR retention remains useful for the narrower domestic-primary-market source, but CSEC now provides the structurally preferable source family for a complete F3 gross-issuance stock-flow submodel. No topology change is authorized until the CSEC common boundary is retained.
bnr_pilot_promotion_blockers: raw source bytes are not retained in repository or a reproducible retained source-vintage acquisition path
generic feedback node remains semantically overloaded across two government loops
a separately preregistered structural decision is still required before narrowing the issuance-yield path to the BNR domestic-primary-market boundary
